# Implementation Plan
<!-- Generated by handover v1.0.1 -->

## Open Questions to Resolve First
- [ ] What are the official or product-canonical output filenames for Codex and Copilot targets — are SPEC.md and TASKS.md the right conventions or should the repo define its own?
- [ ] Should the browser extension version be kept separate from the Python package version, and if so how should that be communicated clearly in docs?
- [ ] Is a lightweight artifact-spec abstraction (each target declares a list of named artifacts with filenames and templates) worth introducing now, or should targets continue to own rendering directly?

## Tasks
- [ ] Full codebase review with Codex *(high priority)*
  Run the full-repo Codex review prompt covering architecture, correctness, product consistency, extensibility, test quality, and OSS readiness. Paste results back for triage.
- [ ] Implement agent-aware output generation *(high priority)*
  Evolve target adapters so each local coding agent generates its own specific artifact files: Claude Code -> CLAUDE.md + PLAN.md, Codex -> SPEC.md + TASKS.md, Copilot -> Copilot-specific files. Add --target all support. Keep design extensible via BaseTarget.
- [ ] Sync versioning and release messaging across repo *(high priority)*
  Align version strings in README, docs/browser-extension.md, extension/manifest.json, CONTRIBUTING.md, and pyproject.toml so all reflect the same release story.
- [ ] Make extension UX agent-neutral *(high priority)*
  Replace 'Send to Claude Code' wording in popup.html, popup.js, and browser-extension docs with agent-neutral language like 'Send to local agent' or 'Generate handover artifacts'.
- [ ] Fix custom-port error messaging in extension *(high priority)*
  In extension/background.js, fix the bug where the error message always shows port 7437 even when a custom port is configured. Error should reflect the actual configured port.
- [ ] Clarify CLI support vs browser-extension support matrix
  Update README and browser-extension docs to clearly separate which chat sources the CLI/parser supports vs which the live browser extension currently supports. Do not imply Gemini or Perplexity are supported by the extension unless implemented.
- [ ] Refresh CONTRIBUTING.md for current repo maturity
  Rewrite CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect current released scope and contribution paths (parsers, targets, docs, extension, MCP). Remove stale phase-progression language.
- [ ] Add end-to-end test for browser bridge pipeline
  Add at least one integration test that covers the full path: sample exported chat -> local server -> generated artifact, without mocking the entire pipeline.
- [ ] Improve Codex target to emit multiple agent-specific files
  Update the Codex target adapter so it emits appropriate multiple artifact files rather than a single AGENTS.md, consistent with the new agent-aware output model.
- [ ] Add Copilot target adapter
  Implement a new Copilot target adapter that generates Copilot-specific artifact files, registered in the target registry.
- [ ] Improve MCP docs and positioning
  Update MCP-related docs to accurately describe the current thin MCP tool wrapper and distinguish it from a fully realized MCP-native cross-agent platform. Keep positioning ambitious but accurate.
- [ ] Add GitHub issue templates and labels
  Add issue templates for bug reports, feature requests, new parser adapters, and new target adapters to improve OSS contributor experience.
